# Fantasy Reskin Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Reskin Công Thành Chiến to fantasy knights & mages (UI F1 + C font, 22 unit SVGs + rigs, terrain/building art, UI text, UI sfx + music) without changing rules, AI or story.

**Architecture:** Unit art source of truth = `docs/anim_demo/<unit>.spec.js` parts; token SVGs generated by `node tools/rig_export.mjs --svg`, rig JSON by `node tools/rig_export.mjs <unit>`; enemy art = `TEAM_SWAP` (red→blue, dark red→dark blue, gold→silver). UI skin lives in `scripts/ui/style.gd` (tokens + theme variations) so screens inherit it.

**Tech Stack:** Godot 4.7.2 GDScript (strict typing), Node 22 (exporter), headless sim/tests, windowed probes for screenshots.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-fantasy-reskin-design.md` · visuals `docs/review/ui_direction_fantasy.html`

## Global Constraints
- Branch `feat/fantasy-reskin` from `1a73512` (last runnable `feat/levels`); worktree `.claude/worktrees/fantasy-reskin`. Never touch `.claude/worktrees/stars-threat` (other session). No push (no remote).
- Do NOT change: `scripts/core/rules.gd` numbers/flags, unit keys, `scripts/core/ai*.gd`, `ai_plan`, bot presets, story/dialogue, mission/chapter/map names, tagline/lede, credits.
- Unit art: 256×256, outline `#2b2220` 7 px, head circle r 54 at (130, 84), p colours `#c9503f` / `#93362b` / gold `#e2c36e`; enemy derived by `TEAM_SWAP`.
- Keep style dir name `chibi`; keep rig part/point names used by `scripts/ui/rig/specs/<unit>.gd` unless that file is updated in the same task.
- UI font: Paytone One (titles, buttons, numbers) + Be Vietnam Pro (body). F1 tokens: paper `#f2e3c0`/`#dcc596`, ink `#231a15`, crimson `#b3262e`/`#7d1720`, gold leaf `#e3b345`, royal blue `#27477a`, hp green `#4f8a3a`.
- Click driver matches button text with `begins_with`: keep "Hết lượt", "Xuất quân", "⚔ Đánh"/"Đánh", "Hủy", "1 đấu 1", "Bắt đầu", "Bỏ qua", "Chơi lại", "Về menu", "Đánh tiếp", "Màn tiếp", "Máy Khó", "Người", "Đánh lại từ đầu" (or update `sim/click_driver.gd` in the same commit).
- Gates after each task: `tools/lint.sh`; tests `MAX_SEC=200 tools/run_guarded.sh <log> -- --headless --path . -s sim/tests.gd` → `tests: N passed, 0 failed`; rig tasks also `rig_smoke` → `RIG SMOKE DONE … fails=0`, 0 `SCRIPT ERROR`.

## Review Focus
- Token frame vs rig frame 0 mismatch (seam when attack starts) → generated SVG + `rig_sheet times=-1,0` per unit.
- Enemy colours: any hard-coded p hex not in TEAM_SWAP stays red on enemy → roster_sheet p/e check.
- Phone 844×390: thicker borders / lip overflow popups (Mộ quân, act popup) → hud_shot `win=844x390`.
- Vietnamese diacritics clipped in Paytone One at large sizes ("Ầ Ặ Ỗ Ữ") → title / banner shots.
- Missing glyphs after removing emoji font from a label (tofu boxes) → grep emoji in scripts/ui after Task B3.

## Phase A · assets (parallel agents, one worktree branch each, merged into feat/fantasy-reskin)

### Task A0: exporter `--svg` + gold→silver swap (done in base commit)
- `tools/rig_export.mjs --svg <unit>|--all`, `RigData.TEAM_SWAP` + `["#e2c36e", "#d9dee3"]`, `docs/rig_port.md` note.

### Task A1: Hiệp Sĩ Chỉ Huy / Hắc Hiệp Sĩ (hero_p, hero_e) — pose B planted sword
**Files:** `docs/anim_demo/hero_p.spec.js`, `hero_e.spec.js`, `assets/units/rig/hero_p.json`, `hero_e.json`, `assets/units/styles/chibi/hero_p.svg`, `hero_e.svg`, `scripts/ui/rig/specs/hero.gd`
- Rest pose = both gauntlets on the pommel, greatsword point-down in front, wide cape with gold trim, 2-layer pauldrons, crown helm + feather wings (e: black steel, horns, red eyes). Attack = wrench sword up → slash (keep one HIT, `a.sound("slash")`), return to planted.
- Verify: parity, `rig_sheet` p/e `times=-1,0,…`, smoke.

### Task A2: Golem Đá (elephant) — new rig
**Files:** `docs/anim_demo/elephant.spec.js`, `assets/units/rig/elephant.json`, `assets/units/styles/chibi/elephant_{p,e}.svg`, `scripts/ui/rig/specs/elephant.gd`
- Biped stone golem, moss, rune glow in team colour on chest; attack = overhead double-fist slam (shockwave, `heavy`, one HIT).

### Task A3: Cung Thủ (archer) + Tu Sĩ Ánh Sáng (drum)
**Files:** spec.js / json / svg / `specs/archer.gd`, `specs/drum.gd`
- Archer: hood, longbow, quiver; attack = draw → loose arrow (`shot` stays arrow). Drum: white robe team-colour trim, short mace + lantern (plain sun disc); attack = raise lantern → light ring + mace bonk (aura visuals keep `drum` sound key).

### Task A4: Vệ Binh (soldier) + Pháp Sư Gọi Hồn (shaman) + Bộ Xương (ghost)
- Soldier/shaman = approved samples in `docs/review/ui_direction_fantasy.html` (`SVG.soldier`, `SVG.shaman`). Ghost = skeleton, rusty sword, broken shield, team-colour rag, green eye flames. Keep rigs (re-cut parts).

### Task A5: Hải Tặc (boat) + Sói Bóng Đêm (wolf) + Máy Bắn Đá (catapult) + Rồng (bird)
- Boat: corsair in small boat (bandana team colour, oar/hook). Wolf: big black wolf, purple smoke paws, team collar. Catapult: medieval wood + iron bands, team banner, helmeted crew. Bird: western dragon (4 legs, 2 wings, team scales, gold/silver horns). Keep rigs.

### Task A6: terrain / buildings
**Files:** `assets/terrain/chibi/castle_{n,p,e}.svg`, `village_{n,p,e}.svg`, `village_x.svg`, `temple.svg`, `bridge.svg`; procedural fallbacks in `scripts/ui/board_paint.gd` only if they show Vietnamese motifs.
- Lâu đài (2 round towers + gate, faction flag), Làng (thatch + timber + small windmill, flag), Làng cháy (collapsed roof, smoke), Giếng Thần (stone well + light), Cầu gỗ (planks + rails).
- Verify: hud_shot / board shot 1280×720.

### Task A7: audio — UI cues + medieval music
**Files:** `scripts/ui/audio.gd`, `assets/sfx/*.wav` (+ `.import`)
- Music: replace pentatonic + glide with Dorian on D (`SCALE = [0,2,3,5,7,9,10]`), plucked lute tone (triangle, fast decay, no glide), drone bass on root/fifth, war-drum thump pattern; keep scheduler shape (`_new_phrase`, `_music_step`, `note()`).
- SFX: `ui` → wax-seal thud, `win` → horn fanfare, `lose` → low horn, `drum` → holy chime, `capture` → short horn; add `page` (paper flip) for UI.
- Re-bake: `godot --headless --path . -s tools/bake_sfx.gd` then `--import`. Remove orphan `m_*.wav` no longer in `recipes()`.

## Phase B · UI skin + text (main session, after A merges)

### Task B1: tokens + buttons + panels (`scripts/ui/style.gd`)
- Add F1 tokens, Paytone One font (`assets/fonts/PaytoneOne-Regular.ttf` + OFL), `_btn` → ink border 3, hard offset shadow 4, pressed = shift by shadow, disabled = faded paper; all variations (MenuBtn, PrimaryBtn, ActBtn/ActHot/ActGo/ActGoHot, IconBtn, ChipBtn/ChipOn, BackBtn, SegBtn/SegOn, CardBtn/CardOn); PanelContainer/Tooltip = parchment + double frame + gold diamond corners (nine-patch baked from SVG at boot).

### Task B2: HUD + end turn + info panel + cards
- `game_hud.gd` (turn banner, gold tag, wax-seal end turn), `hud_widgets.gd` (coin = round gold with star, gear), `info_panel.gd`, `game_cards.gd` end/handoff, unit card stat chips.

### Task B3: icons replace emoji
- `scripts/ui/icons.gd` (`class_name Icons`, `static func tex(name: String, px: int) -> Texture2D`) baking `assets/ui/icons/*.svg` (sword, shield, foot, range, heart, flag, wait, x, target, gear, coin, crown, hammer, fire, book, home, chat, sound, mute, ff, back, lock, sleep, star); buttons use `.icon`, text loses emoji prefix; update click driver matches.

### Task B4: text
- `content/theme.gd`: unit/hero/terrain/faction names + descs + icons, UI `text` with history words; `content/guide.gd` ROLE/PLAY; `scripts/core/content.gd` trait prose; hardcoded UI strings in `scripts/ui/*`; tests that pin names (`sim/tests/rules_2.gd`, `rules.gd`, `content.gd`).

### Task B5: verify
- lint, tests, click driver, rig_smoke, sim spot-check same results; probe shots 1280×720 + 844×390 into `docs/review/fantasy_shots/` + summary page for user.
